note: Issue 110: closed from the home screen, RetroArch never saves its config, so the RetroAchievements token it got at sign-in was lost and the saved password was already forgotten: the next start could not sign in. With 0139 the account is written to retroarch.cfg at sign-in, and the next start signs in with its token.
must_contain: before launch 2 | retroarch.log: [INFO] [RCHEEVOS] RetroAchievements login failed: password is required
before after launch 1, closed from outside | retroarch.cfg: cheevos_username="" cheevos_token=""
after after launch 1, closed from outside | retroarch.cfg: cheevos_username="claudetester" cheevos_token="claudefaketoken0123" | webui.cfg: 0 password line(s), 0 token line(s)
after launch 2 | server: sign-in user=claudetester with=token -> accepted
after | the owner's retroarch.cfg restored: byte-identical
human_check: A real RetroAchievements account on the console: sign in, close RetroArch from the home screen, open it again and start a game.
